description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractBinary for representing binary expressions within the Twig templating engine. It enforces structure for subclasses implementing specific binary operators, managing left and right expressions, and providing a compile method to generate PHP code.

classes.name: AbstractBinary
classes.description: An abstract class representing common behavior for binary expression nodes in Twig, handling constructor validation, and code compilation for binary operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes left and right expressions, issuing deprecation warnings if they are not instances of AbstractExpression.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code for the binary expression by combining compiled left and right expressions with an operator.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to define the specific binary operator during compilation.
